lowres_ok: Nintendo's Switch 2 store trailers (US nsuid 70010000130792, 1280x720, three videos) are the only official copies; Nintendo's YouTube channel is not reachable here (sign-in wall) and no 1080p press-kit file is public
note: Nintendo UK midnight launch event, Argos Tottenham Court Road, London, Wed 4 Nov evening; buyers get N64 box replica and Ocarina key ring while supplies last (VGC, Andy Robinson, 2 Nov 10:50Z, citing Nintendo). Footage: Nintendo store Overview trailer (720p, only official copy), stretches not used by the Geekay Reel (27 to 41 s).
